title: Old theme-named blocks map to a role and layout, and an owner can press Update to new layouts per page, diffed and undoable

source.ref: Theme cohesion sweep (docs/THEME-COHESION.md, ADR-1923). Owner picks 2026-10-29: role blocks and manifest, phased; no live site changes on its own.

detail: Opt-in only. A legacy document renders identically on its own theme before and after the resolver ships. Shipped: lib/blocks/roles/legacy-map.ts converts the blocks whose words carry over one for one (Hero, CTA, Statement, Letter and Gatherings families); blocks with lists the roles cannot take (steps, tiers, services, FAQ items) stay as they are and are listed as kept. components/sites/editor/update-layouts.tsx shows the diff from the page panel's Update to new layouts and commits one undo step. Nothing runs unless the owner presses it.

verify.note: Reads the wiring this row ships; fails on main. The behaviour is pinned by the row's own tests.
